name: Infant Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome

criteria.description: Acute onset of respiratory failure within 7 days of a known clinical insult
Impaired oxygenation defined by oxygenation index (OI) ≥ 4 or oxygen saturation index (OSI) ≥ 5
Bilateral pulmonary infiltrates on chest imaging not fully explained by cardiac failure or fluid overload
No evidence of left atrial hypertension or cardiogenic pulmonary edema

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (acute onset, oxygenation impairment, bilateral infiltrates) must be met with exclusion of cardiogenic causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of respiratory distress such as congenital heart disease or primary pulmonary hypertension.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe hypoxemia refractory to oxygen therapy
searchTerms: oxygen deficiency not improved by oxygen

pathognomonic.symptomName: Diffuse bilateral pulmonary infiltrates on imaging

searchTerms: skin pulling between ribs during breath

rare.symptomName: Persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn
searchTerms: persistent high blood pressure in lungs of newborn
lung blood vessel pressure problems after birth

laboratory: Arterial blood gas showing hypoxemia and respiratory acidosis
Elevated inflammatory markers (e.g. CRP) if secondary infection present
imaging: Chest X-ray showing bilateral diffuse alveolar infiltrates
Lung ultrasound demonstrating B-lines and consolidation
other: Exclusion of cardiac causes by echocardiography
Oxygenation index calculation for severity assessment

distinguishingFeatures: Occurs primarily in preterm infants due to surfactant deficiency
Chest X-ray shows ground-glass appearance without bilateral infiltrates
Severe hypoxemia with normal lung parenchyma on imaging
Responds to inhaled nitric oxide therapy

redFlags: Rapid progression of respiratory failure despite maximal oxygen support
references: De Luca D, et al. The Montreux definition of neonatal ARDS: biological and clinical background. Pediatr Res. 2017.
Khemani RG, et al. Pediatric acute respiratory distress syndrome: definition, incidence, and epidemiology. Pediatr Crit Care Med. 2015.
Orphanet: Infant Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ORPHA:70587)
